correctness.rationale: For the four-site one-excitation basis, exact Pauli action gives H_4|j>=2(|j-1>+|j+1>). The opposite-momentum vectors and every linear combination in their span therefore have energy zero. Fixed excitation makes each one-qubit reduced state diagonal. Substitution into the proven average-purity form of Q gives Q=3/4-[Re(a conjugate(b))]^2, hence the exact interval [1/2,3/4]. The standard-library checker replays both endpoints exactly. No finite experiment is used to prove the continuous formula.

value.rationale: The result corrects a structural symmetry inference in a foundational spectral application of the Meyer–Wallach measure. It gives the complete range on the smallest nontrivial degenerate one-magnon eigenspace, showing that energy and excitation number alone do not determine Q there. This is a motivated boundary/counterexample, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
